scripts.build: tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit && vite build && tauri build
scripts.build:full: tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit && vite build && tauri build --bundles msi
scripts.build:fast: tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit && vite build && tauri build --no-bundle --profile release-fast
scripts.build:thin: tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit && VITE_THIN_CLIENT=1 vite build && VITE_THIN_CLIENT=1 tauri build --config src-tauri/tauri.thin.conf.json
